ranking.metaTitle: {year} Japanese MLB Player Rankings | WAR, HR, ERA, Strikeouts | Overseas Reactions

ranking.gateNote: AVG and OPS require {pa}+ plate appearances; ERA requires {ip}+ innings (to exclude small-sample noise).
